fields.name: DatabasesBase<TConfiguration>.DataConnection data-access operations
fields.contract: DatabasesBase<TConfiguration>.DataConnection accepts a Query contract and its parameter collection, executes asynchronously with caller cancellation, and exposes these result families: scalar return values; typed lists; model mapping from output parameters and/or zero through eight reader result sets; caller-supplied result handling; non-result command execution; and Batch execution. Generic mapping may create a model or populate a caller-supplied model. A Batch executes its commands as one transaction and returns its optional final result. Callers can inspect the resolved connection string and provide named mock results for these operations.
